reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding.*

*CRITICAL — Deduplication uses object identity, not contact ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` keeps separate objects with equal IDs, so `mergeImports` leaves overlapping contacts duplicated, contrary to the README’s first-seen-per-ID contract.

Verified: merging `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada'}]` and `[{id: 1, name: 'Ada updated'}]` returns both contacts.
*Recommended fix:* track seen `contact.id` values and retain only the first contact for each ID.

All 4 existing tests pass, but `test/dedupe.test.js` tests repeated references—not separate objects with the same ID. Add that regression case and a cross-list `mergeImports` test.

No other findings. No files changed.
